name: Gin and Tonic
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the gin.
Top with cold tonic water.
Lift the drink once with a long spoon.
Add a lime wedge if desired.

name: Godfather
steps: Set a large cube in a rocks glass.
Pour the Scotch and amaretto over the cube.
Stir until the glass chills and the mixture softens slightly.
Twist orange peel over the drink if desired.

name: Godmother
steps: Set a large cube in a rocks glass.
Pour in the vodka and amaretto.
Stir around the cube until the liqueur is evenly mixed.

name: White Russian
steps: Fill a rocks glass with ice.
Pour in the vodka and coffee liqueur.
Stir the base until cold.
Float the cold cream over the top.
If you prefer an even texture, stir the cream into the drink before sipping.

name: Vodka Martini
steps: Chill a martini glass.
Measure the vodka and dry vermouth into a mixing glass.
Stir over ice until cold and lightly diluted.
Strain into the martini glass.
Finish with lemon oils or a green olive.

name: Dirty Martini
steps: Chill a martini glass.
Measure the gin or vodka, vermouth and olive brine into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until the brine is evenly dispersed and the glass feels cold.
Strain into the martini glass.
Finish with a pick of green olives.

name: Gibson
steps: Chill a martini glass.
Measure the gin and vermouth into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until thoroughly cold.
Strain into the chilled glass.
Add a drained cocktail onion.

name: Gimlet
steps: Squeeze the lime.
Measure the juice into a shaker with gin and simple syrup.
Shake firmly with ice until cold.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Add a lime wheel if desired.

name: Tom Collins
steps: Fill a Collins or highball glass with ice.
Add the Old Tom gin, lemon juice and syrup.
Top with cold soda.
Stir up from the bottom with a long spoon.
Finish with a lemon wheel and a cherry if available.

name: Gin Rickey
steps: Pour the lime juice into a highball with the gin.
Pack the glass with ice.
Add chilled soda.
Lift the ingredients together with one pass of the spoon.
Finish with a lime wedge.

name: Vodka Soda
steps: Fill a highball with solid ice cubes.
Measure in the vodka.
Pour the cold soda over the cubes.
Give the drink a quick lift with a spoon.
Add a lime wedge if desired.

name: Screwdriver
steps: Prepare fresh orange juice, or chill bottled orange juice.
Fill a highball with ice.
Pour in the vodka and orange juice.
Stir until mixed.
Finish with an orange slice if available.

name: Greyhound
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the vodka or gin.
Pour in cold grapefruit juice.
Stir until mixed through.
Add a lime wedge if desired.

name: Salty Dog
steps: Moisten the lip of a highball with a lime wedge.
Dip the wet rim in a shallow dish of salt.
Fill the glass with ice.
Pour the vodka or gin and grapefruit juice down the center.
Stir gently to keep the salted edge intact.

name: Cape Codder
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure the vodka over the cubes.
Add cold cranberry juice.
Stir until the color looks even.
Finish with a lime wedge if desired.

name: Whisky Highball
steps: Chill a highball.
Pack it with cold, firm ice.
Pour in the whisky.
Stir briefly to chill the whisky.
Add soda down the side of the glass.
Lift once from the bottom with a spoon.
Express lemon oils over the drink if desired.

name: Whiskey and Cola
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the whiskey.
Pour in the cold cola slowly to preserve the fizz.
Stir once from the bottom.
Squeeze in lime if desired.

name: Ranch Water
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the blanco tequila and lime juice.
Add strong, cold sparkling water.
Give the drink a gentle lift with a spoon.
Finish with a lime wedge.

name: Chilcano
steps: Fill a highball with fresh ice.
Measure in the pisco, lime juice and aromatic bitters.
Top with chilled ginger ale.
Stir gently from the bottom.
Slip a lime wheel between the ice and the glass if available.

name: Caipiroska
steps: Cut the lime into small wedges.
Put the wedges in the glass with the sugar.
Press the wedges with a muddler until the juice moistens the sugar, leaving the peel intact.
Add the vodka and crushed ice.
Stir from the bottom until the sugar is dispersed.

name: Gold Rush
steps: Stir the bourbon, lemon juice and honey syrup together in the shaker to loosen the syrup.
Shake over ice until the tin feels cold.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large cube.

name: Brown Derby
steps: Measure bourbon, grapefruit juice and honey syrup into a shaker.
Stir briefly if the syrup is thick.
Shake with plenty of ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Squeeze a strip of grapefruit peel over the surface if available.

name: Amaretto Sour

alternatives.note: Separate an egg and use the white

steps: Measure amaretto, bourbon, lemon juice and syrup into a shaker.
Add egg white if you want foam.
If you added egg white, shake hard without ice to start the foam.
Shake with ice until the drink is cold.
Fine-strain over fresh cubes in a rocks glass.
Finish with lemon peel and a cherry if available.

name: Rob Roy
steps: Measure blended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir over ice until the outside of the glass feels cold.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Add a cocktail cherry if available.

name: Old Pal
steps: Measure equal parts rye, Campari and dry vermouth into a mixing glass.
Stir with ice until cold and lightly diluted.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Press a strip of lemon peel over the drink if desired.

name: Rum Old Fashioned
steps: Place a large cube in a rocks glass.
Add the aged rum, syrup and bitters.
Stir around the ice until the syrup disperses and the glass feels cold.
Twist orange peel over the drink if desired.

name: Negroni Sbagliato
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add the Campari and sweet vermouth.
Stir briefly to chill the base.
Slowly pour in the cold Prosecco.
Lift the drink once with a spoon to combine.
Tuck an orange slice beside the ice.

name: Blue Lagoon
steps: Pack a highball with ice.
Add vodka and blue curaçao.
Pour cold sparkling lemonade over the cubes.
Stir gently until the color is even.
Add a lemon wheel if available.

name: Pimm’s Cup
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Tuck cucumber, orange and strawberry slices among the cubes if available.
Pour in Pimm’s and cold sparkling lemonade.
Lift once from the bottom with a spoon.
Put a fresh sprig of mint at the sipping edge if available.

name: Kamikaze
steps: Measure vodka, triple sec and fresh lime juice into a shaker.
Shake with ice until the tin is cold to the touch.
Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.
Add a lime wheel if desired.

name: Shirley Temple
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Measure in the grenadine and lime juice.
Top with cold ginger ale.
Lift once with a spoon to blend the syrup into the fizz.
Finish with a maraschino cherry if available.

name: Roy Rogers
steps: Fill a highball with ice cubes.
Measure the grenadine into the glass.
Pour in cold cola slowly.
Lift once with a spoon to distribute the syrup.
Finish with a maraschino cherry if available.
